answer: A newcomer joins a mesa of ten, each locking a $3 bond in one pot. Each day the beacon's call wanders to one member, who must post proof of a real task in two hours; the other nine check it before dawn. A forged proof or missed call burns the bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour daily; a farm faking 100 locks $300 and must answer 100 surprise calls daily, each needing new work — the fable of free identities dies at roll-call.
